annotations.summary: {{ $labels.deployment_environment_name }}: {{ humanizePercentage $values.B.Value }} of API requests are failing
annotations.description: More than 2% of rehearse-api requests returned 5xx for 1 minute. Check the deploy markers on the Rehearse dashboard: in Scenario A this is new config running on an old image.

model.expr: (sum by (cloud_provider, deployment_environment_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~".*rehearse-api", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[2m])) or (sum by (cloud_provider, deployment_environment_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~".*rehearse-api"}[2m])) * 0)) / sum by (cloud_provider, deployment_environment_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{job=~".*rehearse-api"}[2m]))
